orders.label: Follow me
orders.meaning: Guard the commander; keep support behind the frontline.

orders.label: Attack
orders.meaning: Advance and engage nearby threats, or focus a selected enemy.

orders.label: Hold
orders.meaning: Defend the chosen anchor; pursue only within ten blocks.

orders.label: Charge
orders.meaning: Commit to a selected enemy with reduced cohesion.

orders.label: Retreat
orders.meaning: Disengage to the destination; ignore enemies and interrupt prior attacks.

formations.label: Shield wall
formations.purpose: Narrow frontage; infantry screen the rear.

formations.label: Banner
formations.purpose: Stand as the war table lays the army out.

modes.name: Domination
modes.summary: Hold the points. First to 300, 15 minutes at most.
modes.howTo: Send troops onto a point to take it; hold it to score. | Reach the target score first, or lead when time ends.
modes.howToDefend: Send troops onto a point to take it; hold it to score. | Reach the target score first, or lead when time ends.

modes.name: Siege
modes.summary: Break the gate and take the keep. About 3 minutes.
modes.howTo: Break the gate; siege troops strike it four times harder. | Seize the keep before the clock runs out.
modes.howToDefend: Hold the yard, then the gate, then the keep. | When the clock runs out, the keep is yours.

modes.name: Convoy
modes.summary: Push the wagon to the refuge. About 7 minutes.
modes.howTo: Stay by the wagon to push it; an enemy beside it stops it. | Reach the refuge before the clock runs out.
modes.howToDefend: Stand by the wagon to stop it. | Hold it until the clock runs out.

modes.name: Survival
modes.summary: Hold the shrine through 7 waves. About 11 minutes.
modes.howTo: Hold the shrine against every wave; clear a wave for its gold. | Lose the shrine for 20 seconds and the night is lost.
modes.howToDefend: Hold the shrine against every wave; clear a wave for its gold. | Lose the shrine for 20 seconds and the night is lost.

campaignChapters.name: The Oath
campaignChapters.chapterEnd: Aldric, alone with the Charter. The lamps flicker once. I swore to protect every person under it. I would like to read it again.

campaignBattles.name: The Drowned Crossings
campaignBattles.briefing: Tidecaller raiders hold the river crossings above the drowned coast. Take them one at a time and teach your banner to follow you.
campaignBattles.reason: The Charter says every wrong is answered. This one first.
campaignBattles.after: A Sunweaver's light sputters in her hand. Aldric: Damp powder. See that it is dry.

campaignBattles.name: The Moon Shrine Watch
campaignBattles.briefing: The graves of Hollowwood are opening under the moon. Hold the shrine with the Order's second banner until the dead lie still.
campaignBattles.reason: The dead wear colours no one has worn in a lifetime.
campaignBattles.after: Aldric reads the faded colours. Tengervald. Struck from the relief list two lifetimes ago. Someone is still answering for it.

campaignBattles.name: Smoke at Ironhold
campaignBattles.briefing: Tidecallers hold the Ironhold gate and the Ironclad cannot take it back alone. Bring their engines up, break the gate, take the keep.
campaignBattles.reason: The river under Ironhold runs the wrong colour. No one asks why.
campaignBattles.after: The smith thanks the Order and does not meet Aldric's eye. A dying raider says one word. Admiral.

campaignBattles.name: The Hunters' Road
campaignBattles.briefing: The council orders the grazing lands cleared for the quarry road. The wagon carries the hunters. Walk beside it through the pass.
campaignBattles.reason: Aldric read the order twice. This is the hunt again.
campaignBattles.after: A boar-kin hunter in the snow: We hid for a hundred years. We stopped hiding.

campaignBattles.name: The Grazing Grounds
campaignBattles.briefing: The grass is ripe and the order is to burn it. Take the grazing grounds before the herds come back for them.
campaignBattles.reason: The quarry road needs the plain. The herds were there first.
campaignBattles.after: The fire does not catch. A quarryman says the stone is cold in the cut.

campaignBattles.name: The Antlered Alpha
campaignBattles.briefing: The quarry road is open and the Wildmoot have come to close it. Old Horn leads them. Hold the five crossings and break his line.
campaignBattles.reason: At the cut lies a carved stone the size of a house.
campaignBattles.after: The Wildmoot line breaks and Old Horn withdraws. Aldric asks what the stone is. Stone, says the quarryman. Aldric orders it covered.

campLessons.text: LESSON 1 OF 4 / Press {key:follow} for Follow me, or {key:retreat} to Retreat. Follow me keeps your army at your side.
LESSON 2 OF 4 / Press {key:formation} for Formation, then aim and click to set your army's shape. Banner stands as your war table laid it out; Wedge breaks a line.
LESSON 3 OF 4 / Press {key:attack} for Attack to send your army at the enemy, or {key:charge} for Charge. A Charge needs a short rest.
LESSON 4 OF 4 / Recruit at your barracks lectern with {key:use}. Trained troops march out from the held point nearest the fight.

tips.text: Press {key:follow} to call your army: it guards you, with support troops behind the front line.
Press {key:attack} to send your army at the enemy, or {key:retreat} to pull it back; retreating troops ignore enemies.
Press {key:charge} to aim a Charge: troops run 25% faster, then need a short rest.
When aiming a Charge or formation, {key:confirm} confirms and {key:cancel} cancels.
Press {key:formation} for the formation tray and click a shape; keys 1 to 4 pick one too.
In a Shield wall, front-rank troops stop 75% of the arrows that strike their front.
Press {key:menu} in battle for the command panel, to order all troops or one group.
The command panel closes after each order; hold Shift while ordering to keep it open.
Domination: hold points to score; first to 300 wins, or the side ahead after 15 minutes.
Every 5 seconds you earn 5 gold, plus 3 per point your side holds (up to 9), and 1 per kill.
Recruit at your barracks lectern with {key:use}; troops march out from the held point nearest the fight.
A banner holds up to 40 troops in a 9 by 6 war table; each troop stands in its own cell.
A House trait switches on when your banner holds enough of that House's troops; field more for a higher tier.
Graveborn, tier I: a fallen troop, except a Legendary, has an 11% chance to rise once at 30% health.
Tidecallers, tier I: troops move 15% faster in water or rain, and their hits slow a foe for 1 second.
A gear set gives a bonus at 2 pieces worn and another at 4; change gear in the Arsenal, in camp.
In the war council, battle starts ten seconds after the last commander readies; Stand down stops it.
The host of a war council sets the mode, map, seats and bot difficulty, and everyone sees them.
With Bots fill seats on, bots take every empty seat when the battle starts.
Hold {key:hints} in battle to see every key hint on screen.
